answer_2.quote: The model training performance was evaluated using mean squared error (MSE)... We evaluated model performance against the bank of human annotators by computing pairwise rank correlations (Kendall, type "c")...

answer_4.quote: The hand-curated list of 434 messages was then presented to anonymous raters on the Amazon Mechanical Turk (mTurk) platform... Participants in mTurk were compensated $0.75 for their time... Rate the negativity or positivity of the statement, from 0 to 100.
answer_4.guideline: Rate the negativity or positivity of the statement from 0 (strongest negative emotion) to 100 (strongest positive emotion), where 50 is emotionally neutral
